metadata.description: Marketplace for the qa-crawler plugin — an autonomous QA coverage crawler (deterministic engine + ledger + Neko browser + judgment layer).

plugins.name: qa-crawler
plugins.description: Autonomous QA coverage crawler: maps the whole app and inspects every node (the inverted maze). Deterministic MCP engine (frontier, dedup, replay, SQLite coverage ledger, a11y/visual/functional checks) + qa-crawl skill + /qa-crawl command + orchestrator/worker subagents. Drives a visible Neko browser (local or remote) with per-session tab isolation. NOTE: run `sh setup.sh` in the plugin directory once after install (native SQLite + Chromium).
